name: pebbles
advice: Budget: about 60 triangles (136 today, 2.3 times the budget): a few crossed alpha-tested cards; gone past a short distance.
Painted on the ground at any distance but the closest; a decal.
1 round part(s) (cylinders, prisms): thin ones as boxes without caps or 3-sided prisms and the fake rounded-corner shader; caps that touch another part left out.
32 bytes a vertex: quantize (position 3 x int16, normal as 2 x int8 octahedral, colour 4 x uint8): about 12-16 bytes (KHR_mesh_quantization).
5 MB of textures (as counted for this object, shared textures included): GPU-compressed KTX2 (ETC1S/UASTC), the size its pixels on screen need.
